name: midge
description: Midge: Private Rooms with Public Rules, on NEAR Protocol

scripts.start:daemon: node -e 'import("./src/api/server.js").then(m => new m.FlyApiDaemon({ port: 3000 }).start().then(s => console.log("Midge Daemon live on port " + s.port)))'
scripts.build:wasm: cd contracts/fly-coordinator && RUSTFLAGS="-C link-arg=-s" cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release
scripts.build:site: node scripts/build-site-data.mjs && node scripts/build-site-cards.mjs && node scripts/build-site-3d.mjs
scripts.build:wasm:testsigner: cd contracts/fly-coordinator && RUSTFLAGS="-C link-arg=-s" cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --features test-signer-override --target-dir target-testsigner
scripts.build:wasm:multisig: cd contracts/public-multisig && RUSTFLAGS="-C link-arg=-s" cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release
scripts.build:wasm:market: cd contracts/public-market && RUSTFLAGS="-C link-arg=-s" cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release
scripts.build:wasm:baseline: cd contracts/public-auction && RUSTFLAGS="-C link-arg=-s" cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run knip && npm run dup && npm run cycles && npm run check:large-files && npm run deps:weight
scripts.test:roost: node --test tests/browser-client.test.js tests/browser-verify.test.js tests/compose-escrow.test.js tests/compose-failclosed.test.js tests/escrow-reader.test.js tests/hosted-roost-escrow.test.js tests/hosted-roost-invoices.test.js tests/hosted-roost-keycheck-message.test.js tests/hosted-roost-rounds.test.js tests/invoice.test.js tests/payroll-surfaces.test.js tests/playground-page.test.js tests/playground-round.test.js tests/preflight-explainer.test.js tests/preflight.test.js tests/room-abandon-clients.test.js tests/room-service-escrow.test.js tests/roost-client-abandon.test.js tests/roost-compose-rpc.test.js tests/roost-expected.test.js tests/roost-image-stage.test.js tests/roost-server-escrow.test.js tests/roost-server-payroll.test.js tests/roost-server-signed-env.test.js tests/signed-bid-helper.test.js tests/signed-input-keycheck.test.js tests/system-wholeness.test.js
